summary: OpenRouter for Startups grants approved pre-Series B venture-scalable startups building AI-native products full-time up to $5,000 in universal inference credits across 500+ models, plus waived processing fees (platform and BYOK) for 12 months. Marketing and FAQ state those figures; program terms say amounts and duration are at OpenRouter's discretion, with a ceiling of $5,000 and/or fee waivers up to 12 months. Most credits expire 6 months after issuance. Applications require an approved-partner referral, a public company website, a professional company-domain email associated with an individual (not admin@, support@, ops@ or similar generic aliases), a valid OpenRouter account with under $500 lifetime spend, and no prior startup-program credits.
claim_steps: Confirm you are a pre-Series B venture-scalable startup building an AI-native product full-time, with a public company website and approved-partner referral.
Use an individual company-domain email, not a generic alias, and a valid OpenRouter account with under $500 lifetime spend and no prior startup-program credits.
Submit the application on openrouter.ai/startup-program (rolling review).
If approved, credits and fee waivers are applied to the OpenRouter account tied to the applicant email.
Use credits across OpenRouter models; BYOK processing fees are also waived for 12 months if approved. Most credits expire 6 months after issuance.

social_proof.text: If approved, Participants may receive promotional credits and/or waived or discounted platform fees. OpenRouter determines the availability, amounts, and duration of any Program benefits in its discretion. Program benefits may include credits in an amount up to $5,000 USD and/or waived platform fees for a period of up to twelve (12) months.
